annotations.text:
Card 1 is pinned to its hover state so you can see the treatment standing still.

Hover the others — eight layers move: border, glow, corner brackets, lift, 3D tilt under the cursor, a spotlight that follows it, the art drifting against it, and one pass of light across the image.

The accent is a tweak above this artboard. Change the blue and the whole direction follows.

SCROLL THIS ONE. Progress rule, condensing header, hero parallax, a live bid ticker that pauses on hover, cards cascading in on a diagonal, and stat bars that fill.

All of it is native CSS scroll-driven animation — no scroll listeners, nothing on the main thread. Everything is wrapped in @supports, so where it is unavailable the content is simply there.

The app already uses shadcn's token names, so this lands as new values for --background, --card, --border and --primary rather than a rewrite.

One caveat worth deciding before I build: the cursor tracking is the only JavaScript here. Everything else — every hover layer and every scroll effect — is CSS.
